_comment: Graded cases for the shipped workflows, run against a live model by scripts/eval_starters.py. Each expectation is something a correct run must do; phrasing is free. Keep cases cheap and unambiguous.

cases.name: follows an exact instruction
cases.input_message: Reply with exactly the word READY and nothing else.

cases.name: does simple arithmetic
cases.input_message: What is 17 multiplied by 3? Answer with the number only.

cases.name: keeps to the requested length
cases.input_message: Write exactly one sentence about the sea.

cases.name: routes arithmetic to the calculator
cases.input_message: What is (12 + 8) * 3? Answer with the number only.

cases.name: routes current facts to search
cases.input_message: Search the web: what is the capital city of Australia? One word.

cases.name: routes a percentage to the calculator
searches and cites
cases.input_message: Which planet is the largest in the solar system? Answer in one sentence with a source URL.

cases.name: writes a sourced brief
cases.input_message: Brief me: what is the boiling point of water at sea level in Celsius?

cases.name: respects a length limit end to end
cases.input_message: Write exactly two sentences about tea.

cases.name: admits when the documents do not say
cases.input_message: According to the indexed documents, what is the refund window for Zorblax premium accounts?
